name: Embermoth
description:
A moth of smouldering ash, its wings veined with live embers. Where it bursts, everything catches.

{key.summon} sends it where you aim, within {range} paces. Costs {cost} summon charge. It scatters embers that scorch every resident nearby and leave them burning.

text.callHint: {key.summon} · Send the Embermoth where you aim
